title: Swiss lake water levels in the dry summer of 2026: code, report and figures
description:
Code (Jupyter notebooks), report and figures analysing the record low lake levels in Switzerland in summer 2026: lake level climatology since 1970, reconstructed inflow and the role of glaciers and lake regulation, Simstrat surface temperature and evaporation, and SWOT satellite levels of small lakes.

Third-party input data (FOEN, MeteoSwiss, CAMELS-CH, Simstrat via Alplakes, SWOT via Alplakes, swisstopo) are not included in this archive; the notebooks download them from the original providers (see README).
